Description: I would like to revert back to warehouse and create a wine storage warehouse for long-term storage. We will pick up wine, put it into the warehouse on racks, and enter it into an inventory management system. We will pull wine and deliver it upon request. Wine collectors put wine into storage for several years without moving it so the impact will be very low. I will hire one person to assist me. It is very simple. I will build a wall to enclose the room, add climate controls, install shelves/racking, and add a security system. There will be no change to the dwelling unit.

Description: Paragon Philanthropy Inc. provides back-office advisory, due diligence, vetting, and administrative services to U.S. grantmaking nonprofits to support their international grantmaking. Our clients include U.S. private foundations, donor advised funds, and grantmaking public charities. Our services include: 1. Advising U.S. grantmakers on the selection of foreign grantees for grant funding. 2. Conducting counterterrorism screening of foreign and domestic individuals and organizations. 3. Supporting grantmaking clients in implementing Expenditure Responsibility steps in conjunction with their grants. 4. Sourcing Equivalency Determination letters from Qualified Tax Practitioners (QTPs) on behalf of grantmaking clients and providing associated back-office and facilitation services.
